description: A source that produces chunks over time: files, request bodies, `process.stdin`. Consume it with `for await`.
A destination for chunks: files, HTTP responses. `write()` returns `false` when its buffer is full.
One piece of a stream, a `Buffer` (or a string with an `encoding`) up to `highWaterMark` bytes. Boundaries are arbitrary.
The buffer size a stream aims for (64 KB for files). It bounds memory per stream.
`async function*` yields values over time; callers iterate with `for await`. Ideal to turn chunks into lines or records.
Slowing the producer when the consumer cannot keep up, so buffers do not grow without limit.
